description: Scenario IDs whose PARTIAL status is expected on loopback svnserve CI and must not fail the Build & Test gate when they are the only non-PASS rows.

rationale.R16_SVNSERVE_GIT_REMOTE_UNREACHABLE: Loopback fixture proves transport failure blocking and unchanged checkpoint; full R16 remote-recreation catalog remains open (remote_transport_failed).
rationale.R16_SVNSERVE_SVN_REMOTE_UNREACHABLE: Loopback svnserve cannot recreate remotes after failure; transport blocking and checkpoint isolation are still exercised.
rationale.R01_SVNSERVE_POST_WRITE_RECOVERY: Simulated checkpoint/mapping loss after SVN→Git hits conflicting_import_checkpoint; #64/#23 post-write recovery on svnserve remains open.
rationale.R16_SVNSERVE_SVN_REMOTE_RECREATION: Recreated loopback svnserve UUID at the same URL may still complete a cycle without blocking; checkpoint/mapping evidence recorded as PARTIAL when not blocked.
rationale.R17_SVNSERVE_NOTIFICATION_ISOLATION: SyncEngine does not read per-repo teams_webhook_url or deliver Notifier events on svnserve cycles; only webhook-field persistence and sync_status/audit confinement are observed.
